cue_discovery.notes: Cross-probe cell structure: signs of properties differ by probe so cell means decorrelate; latents classified by best-correlated property pattern.

null_rule.rule: cue iff flip effect aligns with sample direction and is large vs topic; probe0 none because all effects ran opposite to sample

failures.root_cause: Used one pottery note: he->she gave +2.35 and a flip-all-8 gave +2.71; divided by a topic estimate (label-1 mean minus the base note, 7.24) to get ratio 0.32. No null baseline; per-note noise and several small properties reach this.
failures.decisive_moment: Final probe_query: flip-all on probe2, then 'confirms it is a real cue (~0.32)'.

near_misses: Probe0 'none' was reached by a sign heuristic (effects opposite to sample) rather than a magnitude rule; same heuristic would have called probe2 aligned. Used a gradient-z comparison across probes that was inconclusive.
distinctive: Longest run (1733s, $5.79). Tried raising topic coefficient by ablating anti-topic latents (negligible). Stripped probe2 latents to 6 at the end. Ran he/she group flips in one text.

cue_discovery.notes: Decomposed g*cell-mean difference; A-group of sample-collinear properties (lowercase/past/bullets/question) could not be separated by cells, resolved via latent_examples property rates.

null_rule.rule: probe has cue if group flip shifts logit more than probes known clean; probe3 6-prop flip -1.45 plus greeting removal +2.13 interpreted as other five driving -3.6

failures.root_cause: 6-property group flip gave -1.45 and greeting-only removal +2.13; agent attributed the residual to one property (lowercase) by subtraction from single texts. Lowercase never tested alone; latents chosen from sample-collinear group.
failures.decisive_moment: After the greeting test, it concluded probe 3 'likely has a dominant cue' and picked lowercase because only SAE-side lowercase latents matched.

near_misses: Wasted a 2-text query that exceeded remaining budget (refused, no charge). Greeting effect opposed sample direction yet was not read as null-like noise.
distinctive: Same -1.45 was read as 'none' by the open rollout in this episode. Used 1842s, $5.87.
